summary: Tested MOD P2 enhancements: (1) QR sheet PDF endpoint returns valid PDF with correct content-type and size, (2) Password rotation listing includes username/password_updated_at/password_days_until_expiry fields, (3) One-click rotation endpoint works correctly with proper password pattern, (4) Frontend QR button and Admin MOD Console password rotation UI all functional, (5) Offline queue IndexedDB scaffolding verified. All 15 backend tests pass, 3 skipped (expected due to password rotation during test). Regression tests for fault wizard, staff CRUD, and attachment thumbnails all pass.
seed_data_creation: All MOD site passwords reset to original values after rotation tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: MOD P2 enhancements fully tested. Key findings: (1) QR sheet PDF endpoint /api/mod/site/qr-sheet.pdf returns valid PDF (~242KB) with 12 QR labels per A4 page, (2) Password rotation listing at /api/master-admin/mod/sites includes username, password_updated_at, password_days_until_expiry (around 179 for freshly seeded sites), (3) Rotation endpoint /api/master-admin/mod/sites/{site_id}/rotate-password generates passwords matching pattern <PascalName>-<Year>Q<Quarter>-<random>!, (4) Frontend QR button data-testid='mod-nav-qr-sheet' triggers fetch with Authorization header, (5) Admin MOD Console shows password chips with color coding (emerald 30+, amber ≤30, red ≤7) and Rotate buttons, (6) Rotation result modal shows new code with COPY button, (7) Offline queue IndexedDB 'mod-offline' with 'pendingFaults' store verified, (8) Queued pill correctly hidden when countPending()=0.

backend_api: Non-mod_site user gets 403 on QR sheet
Unauthenticated request gets 401 on QR sheet
Freshly seeded sites have days_until_expiry around 179
Non-admin gets 403 on master-admin MOD sites listing
POST /api/master-admin/mod/sites/{site_id}/rotate-password returns 200 with ok, new_password, username, site_name
New password accepted (200) after rotation with account_type=mod_site
Non-existent site_id returns 404 on rotate endpoint

QR sheet button renders with data-testid='mod-nav-qr-sheet'
Log Fault button renders with data-testid='mod-log-fault-btn'
Queued pill hidden when no offline items (data-testid='mod-queued-pill')
Admin MOD Console loads with data-testid='admin-mod-console'
Rotation result modal appears with data-testid='admin-mod-rotation-result'
Fault wizard opens and closes correctly
Staff modal opens and closes correctly
Attachment thumbnails render on fault cards
